name: tp-final-lab-iv
description: Raiz del TP: levanta la API (backend) y la WEB (frontend) en simultaneo

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix API" "npm run dev --prefix WEB"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm start --prefix API" "npm run dev --prefix WEB"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix API && npm install --prefix WEB
